nodes.label: Attachment content ranges and sync staging
Stored files and canonical attachment rules
Mac Range Stream
nodes.rationale: Coordinates bounded 32 MiB ranges with acknowledged 64 KiB frames and exact range, binding, identity, cancellation and missing-ack checks across native and bridge layers.

nodes.label: iOS Transport Receiver
nodes.rationale: Wraps mobile window.fetch to preserve WebKit's required receiver when inventory and cloud transports invoke it.

nodes.label: Android Saved-settings Consent Acceptance
nodes.rationale: Verifies saved-setting changes through revision-guarded APIs and requires renewed native consent while preserving inventories and byte hashes.

nodes.label: Retained File History
nodes.rationale: Stores immutable file content in accounted attachments and Timeline while restore commands retain only retry metadata.

nodes.label: Android History Exports
nodes.rationale: Negotiates fileExportVersion 1.0.0, verifies exact authorized ranges before Save As and reads the provider document back before success; avoids arbitrary URL fetching and general WebView download listeners.

nodes.label: iOS History Exports
nodes.rationale: Validates immutable attachment metadata, reads bounded ranges into private cache, verifies fingerprints and publishes an exclusive copy into a one-use Files selection, with exact-origin and owner checks.

nodes.label: Android Binary Upload Ranges
nodes.rationale: Uses strictly ordered correlated frames, nonce acknowledgements, bounded backpressure, verified ranges and existing bridge and owner checks; the 1.4 capability depends on WebView ArrayBuffer support.

nodes.label: Foreground Conflict Retention
nodes.rationale: Separates conflict capture from sync/checkpoint publication using explicit retention planning and a version-2 journal intent.

nodes.label: Attachment Inventory Reads
nodes.rationale: Reads only moderation.status and excludes provider diagnostics and dates.

nodes.label: Native Mixed Fixture
nodes.rationale: Retains legacy fallback coverage by default and can select the canonical desktop manager with negotiated native compound/batch/authorization context and scoped TLS.

nodes.label: Proof Validation
nodes.rationale: Rejects legacy or missing worker parity when the modern lane is requested.

nodes.label: Server PUT Observations
nodes.rationale: Retained IDs, exact hashes, and admission/HTTP timing expose transport and cost without cached authorization.
